data.title: Charles Schwab and Anthropic to Bring Claude to Independent Registered Investment Advisors
data.description: In WESTLAKE, Texas, and HUNTINGTON BEACH, California, Schwab Advisor Services, a division of Charles Schwab that aids independent registered investment advisors (RIAs) in their growth and achievements, disclosed a partnership with Anthropic. They will introduce Anthropic's latest product, Claude for Financial Advisors, to over 16,000 independent RIAs served by Schwab. Claude for Financial Advisors is tailored to assist advisors in their daily tasks, from preparing for client meetings to managing investments.

data.title: Zocks Brings Client Conversation Context to New Claude for Financial Advisors
data.description: A partnership has been formed between Zocks and Anthropic to integrate personal client data from Zocks with the new wealth management solution, Claude for Financial Advisors. This collaboration allows financial advisors to utilize Claude's advisor-specific tools alongside the latest client context gathered by Zocks. Advisors now have the ability to create tailored analyses and reports for their clients using the combined resources. The wealth management solution offers a library of features and is designed to enhance the overall financial advisory experience.

data.title: Dynasty Financial Partners Builds its Next-Generation AI OS for Wealth on Claude
data.description: Dynasty Financial Partners, a prominent wealthtech platform for independent RIAs, has introduced the latest version of Dynasty AI in St. Petersburg, Fla. This advanced AI operating system for wealth management, utilizes Anthropic’s Claude models. With this technology, advisors are able to inquire about any aspect of their clients, accounts, or documents and promptly receive answers. The AI can then assist in creating proposals, reports, and completing paperwork for review without the need for extensive manual work. This innovation marks a substantial advancement in streamlining wealth management processes, benefiting the financial industry as a whole.

data.title: Orion Expands Anthropic Collaboration as Launch Partner for Claude for Financial Advisors
data.description: In Omaha, Nebraska, Orion announced a new collaboration with Anthropic at the Future Proof Festival. They introduced Orion's MCP connector for Claude for Financial Advisors. This tool is designed to enhance the services offered to financial advisors. By utilizing Orion's connector within the Claude for Financial Advisors plugin, advisors can easily request client updates, meeting preparation assistance, or insights on their pipeline using simple language. The responses are generated from the advisor's real-time data from their Orion Connect portfolio and Redtail CRM records. This integration aims to streamline the process of client interactions and provide valuable insights. The tool is poised to revolutionize how advisors prepare for client meetings, with the potential to significantly impact the financial advisory industry.
